'''House Maclain''' was one of the known [[Nobility|Noble]] [[House]]s of [[Malkier]] until the nation's [[Fall of Malkier|fall]] in {{ne|955}}.

The only known member of the House was Lady [[Breyan Mandragoran|Breyan Maclain]], who married [[Lain Mandragoran]].
